text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: elevated error rate and latency observed for canary deployment 'redwood-chat-v2.3.1-quant' in us-west-2 (auto-canary). Error-rate spike started ~1955001190. Severity: P1. 

sara (oncall): I'm on it. Starting triage — paging oncall runbook, will grab logs and canary diffs. 

alex (ml): saw the alert. quick note: canary runs show generation timeouts and occasional NaNs in logits. Posting initial diff and a small sample of failures. (sharing artifact link) https://internal/redwood/canary/diff/1955001234 

maria (infra): sara — any evidence of infra changes? autoscaler events? 
sara (oncall): checking. No infra deploys in last 2 hours. IG activity steady. Autoscaler event at 1955001100 was a small scale-up, nothing unusual. 

jima (eng-sre): +1, re-checking GPU health and node logs now. Pulling kube events. 

alex (ml): quick paste of problematic tokens from canary samples: 
```
Sample ID: c-4712
Input len: 1.2k tokens
Model variant: v2.3.1-quant
Error: generation timeout after 12s (inference loop)
Log snippet: softmax returned NaN for head 3 at step 97
Last logits snapshot:
[... , 1.23e-45, NaN, 0.05, ...]
```

sara (oncall): customer-impact estimate: ryan, can you confirm support signals? 

ryan (support): seeing ~110 distinct customer requests failing over the past 5m. Mostly long chat sessions (>800 tokens). Affected region: us-west-2. Customer-facing page shows some 504s. Rough user impact ~1.8% of total traffic in window. Escalated to growth-tier customers via email. 

maria (infra): kube node logs: one GPU node showed nv-hostengine warnings at 1955001185 but recovered. No OOMs. dmesg has a few driver messages. Attaching log extract: 
```
[1955001185] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:03:00): 79, GPU has fallen off the bus
[1955001192] NVRM: GPU recovered, reinitialized
```

alex (ml): interesting — quantized kernels are more sensitive to denorms. If the GPU briefly dropped, we could get corrupted cache/partial tensors producing NaNs downstream. Hypothesis A: transient GPU hiccup corrupted KV cache or intermediate tensors for some in-flight requests. Hypothesis B: model variant v2.3.1-quant has an edge-case in softmax handling for very long sequences. 

sara (oncall): timeline so far (building): 
- 1955001100 autoscaler scale-up (no deploy)
- 1955001185 nv-hostengine warning on node-gpu-7
- 1955001190 first alert from canary monitor
- 1955001195 increased customer 504s reported by support
- 1955001234 pager triggered (this thread)

jima (eng-sre): running quick KV cache scrub on canary nodes. command: 
```bash
# scrub KV cache (canary nodes)
ssh canary-node-1 'sudo systemctl restart redwood-kv-cache && journalctl -u redwood-kv-cache -n 200'
```

eng-ops-bot: Deployed temporary route: canary->fallback-model (v2.2.x) for new requests in us-west-2 at 1955001280. Traffic shift ~15% of canary traffic. 

alex (ml): thanks — can we pin canary clients to fallback model for now? If the NaN is model-specific, pinning prevents new affected sessions. I propose rollback of canary rollout immediately. 

maria (infra): rolling rollback of canary: steps below. Will coordinate with sara/jima for safety checks. 
```
# rollback canary to v2.2.x
redwood deploy rollback --service redwood-chat --to-version v2.2.9 --selector canary --region us-west-2
# verify
redwood health check --service redwood-chat --region us-west-2
```

sara (oncall): quick decision: initiate rollback of canary (pin to v2.2.9) and scrub KV caches. Keep flighted traffic on fallback model until we finish RCA. Approving now. :thumbsup: 

jima (eng-sre): executing rollback now. ETA ~2m. Will watch error-rate. 

(2 minutes later) 
eng-ops-bot: Rollback complete at 1955001345. Canary rerouted to v2.2.9. Metrics trending: error-rate returning to baseline, latency back to expected. 

ryan (support): customer errors drop significantly after rollback. Next update to customers: incident mitigated, follow-up RCA coming. 

alex (ml): saving artifacts: full canary log bundle + failing sample set uploaded to s3://redwood-incident/1955001234/artifacts.tar.gz 

sara (oncall): good work. Now capturing hypotheses in-thread for RCA: 
- H1 (primary): transient GPU driver hiccup caused corrupted intermediate tensors for in-flight quantized model executions (evidence: nv-hostengine warnings + NaNs in logits). 
- H2: quantized kernel numerical instability for very long sequences introduced NaNs (evidence: failures concentrated on >800 token requests). 
- H3: recent model build introduced a regression in softmax post-processing for quantized pathway (evidence: only v2.3.1-quant affected). 

alex (ml): next steps for RCA: 
1) Re-run failing samples on a controlled cluster with v2.3.1-quant and verbose fp32 fallback to reproduce NaN. 
2) Run the same samples on v2.3.1 (non-quant) to see if issue is quant-specific. 
3) Add stricter numeric guards in softmax to clamp denorms. 

maria (infra): infra follow-ups: 
- Check GPU firmware and driver versions on node-gpu-7, correlate with other nodes.
- Add alerting for nv-hostengine warnings to surface earlier.
- Add canary node isolation to prevent corrupted GPU state from affecting other nodes. 

jima (eng-sre): I'll create an 'in-incident' timeline doc and drop logs + kernel traces into the incident bucket. Flagging for postmortem owners. 

sara (oncall): handoff plan: I'm handing this to jima for deeper dst analysis and alex for model reproduction. I'll stay on-call for customer comms. If either of you finds a smoking gun, ping here. 

jima (eng-sre): taking over for RCA. Assigning follow-ups: 
- jima: infra kernel trace + GPU firmware check (due 1955005000)
- alex: reproduce on repro cluster + test softmax guard (due 1955007200)
- maria: alerting + canary isolation (due 1955003600)
- sara: customer communications summary + postmortem draft (due 1955008640)

alex (ml): quick repro command I'm running: 
```bash
# replay failing session with verbose numerics
python tools/replay_sample.py --model redwood-chat-v2.3.1-quant --sample c-4712 --verbose-numeric --compare-fp32 true
```

ryan (support): CS update sent: "We’re rolling back the recent canary for stability and investigating. No further action required from customers." :white_check_mark: 

sara (oncall): closing the pager for active mitigation. We'll keep this thread as the RCA coordination hub. Thanks team. :heart: 

eng-ops-bot: Pager resolved at 1955001450 (mitigated by rollback + routing). Incident record created: IR-1955001234. 

(reactors) alex: :eyes:, jima: :rocket:, maria: :+1:, ryan: :white_check_mark:
